uom.description: Unit of measure for the material quantity (e.g., sf, lf, ea).

quantity.description: Amount of material used, in the specified unit of measure.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this material was logged for.

time_and_material_entry_id.description: Identifier of the Time & Material entry this material belongs to.

material_id.description: Identifier of the associated material in the Materials catalog microservice, formatted as a UUID. Null when the material is not linked to a catalog record.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this material entry was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this material entry was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this material entry was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this material entry.

login.description: Email address of the user who created this material entry.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this material entry.
